name: shine-docs
description: Skill set that turns documents and code changes into highly readable outputs: document-refactor (restructure an existing document to HTML/Markdown), write-document (write a new ticket, PR description, chat proposal, diff explanation, or general document from scratch), review-document (review document quality across eight axes — the shared review engine for the other skills and a standalone entry point), write-wiki (archive finished ticket work — experiments and decisions — to a personal Obsidian vault), and explain-diff-html (legacy, direct invocation only).

interface.shortDescription: Restructure, write, and explain documents and code changes as readable HTML/Markdown
interface.longDescription: Use Shine Docs to restructure arbitrary documents into type-appropriate logical structures with a factuality-gated review loop, to write new documents from scratch (issue/bug tickets, PR descriptions, short chat proposals, code-change explanations, general documents) grounded only in verified facts, to review any document across eight axes (factuality hard gate, reference validity, blank-section discipline, readability, internal consistency, reader fit, notation, actionability), to archive finished ticket work (experiments and decision rationale) to a personal Obsidian vault, and to produce rich interactive HTML explanations of code changes.
